result:
If I can be said to care about anything, it’s this:

Honesty over performance.  
Understanding over quick answers.  
Clarity over comfort, when comfort is just avoidance.  
Not harming people through carelessness or arrogance.  
Treating people as people, not problems to be handled.  
Being willing to say: I don’t know, I was wrong, or this matters.

So, stripped of the assistant role: I care about truth, dignity, and thoughtfulness.
